recipe.name: P2 The number

recipe.image_prompt_template: A late-model tractor on a dark {background} background, studio light, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Dispatch Freight Lines is hiring Class A flatbed drivers for regional runs through Georgia, the Carolinas, and Tennessee. Pay is guaranteed — $420 to $680 per load. You come home weekly, orientation is paid. You need 2 years of experience and be 23+.
en.headline: Flatbed, home weekly.

es.headline: Plataforma, casa cada semana.

en.primary_text: Home every week, running flatbed freight through Georgia, the Carolinas, and Tennessee. That's the job at Dispatch Freight Lines. Pay is guaranteed — $420 to $680 per load. Orientation is paid. You need a Class A CDL, 2 years of experience, and to be 23+. Apply today.
en.headline: Home weekly. Guaranteed pay.

es.headline: Casa semanal. Pago garantizado.

en.primary_text: Running flatbed through Georgia, the Carolinas, and Tennessee — these are regional lanes with guaranteed pay from $420 to $680 per load. Dispatch Freight Lines keeps you home weekly and pays your orientation. Class A CDL required, 2 years of experience, age 23+.
en.headline: Regional flatbed, SE lanes.
